text: Seabrook Town logró una gran remontada para ganar 4-2 a Harbour City en la Northbridge League. Aunque Harbour City empezó bien y anotó sus 2 goles con un juego paciente y pases cortos, se quedó con un jugador menos tras la expulsión de Joon Whitfield al minuto 43[#871][#905]. Seabrook Town, con un estilo de juego amplio y muchos centros desde las bandas, apretó en la segunda mitad con mucha presión y juego directo, lo que les permitió marcar 4 goles y superar su expectativa de goles (xG 3.48, que significa que sus goles fueron chances muy claras al azar)[#1361][#1448]. Destacó Kian Romano, que entró fuerte al final y metió 2 goles seguidos en el tiempo de descuento para asegurar la victoria[#1882][#1906]. Marek Barros de Harbour City fue el mejor jugador con un gol, 2 asistencias y muchas recuperaciones[#975]. Fue un partido emocionante por la remontada y el cambio táctico de Seabrook para darle vuelta al marcador.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in es

- Seabrook Town scored 4 goals while Harbour City scored 2, with Seabrook having a higher xG of 3.48 vs 1.0 for Harbour City [#1104, #1448, #1882, #1906].
- Marek Barros (Harbour City) was player of the match with 1 goal, 2 assists, 9 interceptions, and a rating of 9.8 [#975].
- Joon Whitfield (Harbour City) received a red card at 43', impacting Harbour City's play [#871].
- Seabrook Town made a tactical change at 65' increasing press and directness, which preceded their scoring comeback [#1361].
- Kian Romano scored two late goals (90+2' and 90+3') to seal the win for Seabrook Town [#1882, #1906].

- Seabrook Town's comeback and eventual victory were founded on their 3-4-3 formation emphasizing wide, crossing play, enabling them to exploit wide spaces and deliver crosses leading to critical goals (e.g., the goals by Kian Romano) [#1906, #1882].
- Harbour City, playing a 4-2-3-1 with a patient short passing style, built up their first goal with an extended 17-pass sequence over 57 seconds reflecting possession-focused, methodical buildup [#905].
- Seabrook Town effectively used quick regains and direct counter-attacks after turnovers to score high-xG goals, particularly in the late game, supported by through passes exploiting Harbour City's higher line after their tactical change to press more and play direct [#1104, #1882, #1884].
- The tactical changes near the end, where Harbour City pressed higher with more direct play and a higher line, likely opened spaces that Seabrook Town exploited on counters and quick transitions, as shown by Romano’s late goals [#1884, #1882, #1906].
- Harbour City’s pressure intensity (PPDA ~7.3-7.9) was generally lower than Seabrook Town’s (PPDA ~5.0-6.2), indicating Seabrook Town pressed more aggressively, fitting their pressing and direct style especially after their half-time tactical adjustments [#1361].
- The high number of turnovers for Seabrook Town (25 total, 14 in second half) suggest their aggressive pressing led to regains and quick attacks, fitting their pressing trap and direct approach especially in the chasing phase [#1361].
